content: (The sky is a vast, clear expanse, with barely a cloud in sight, offering a moment of tranquility.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Thaer, Horse, Daegon, Serana, Lydia) (Malborn unequipped clothes) (Malborn equipped clothes) (Malborn equipped boots) (The location is now Katla's Farm.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): delphine, Daegon, chicken, Lydia, Horse) (MJR: Yes, Malborn's all set.; Delphine: Good. I have your invitation to the party. But the only way you're going to get past the guards is if they really believe you're an invited guest. Which means you need to look the part, and not be armed to the teeth. Here, put this on.)

Carriage Driver: Fine night for travel, ain't it? Clear skies, no rain in sight. You should be grateful for that, boy. traveler: Indeed. The darkness suits those of us who prefer the quiet hours. You keep late watch for a stable child, Blaise. Blaise: I don't sleep much these nights. Too many thoughts. And the horses get restless when something's in the air.

Blaise: The guard on the wall said he'd rather be there than sleeping in a stable. I guess he's got a point. Carriage Driver: Aye, but that wall gets cold and empty, boy. At least you got the warmth of the animals. More than some can say. traveler: Warmth is overrated. I find the chill keeps the mind sharp. Tell me, stable boy, do you ever think of leaving this farm behind? Blaise: All the time. But where would I go?
Blaise: I don't know where I'd go.
